# Croom CPR p. 117 — Baptisms Aug 1876 – Mar 1877

**Source image:** `page_117_baptism_aug1876_mar1877.jpg` (this directory)
**NLI:** Croom parish 0881, microfilm 02427/07
**Coverage:** Aug 1876 – Mar 1877

## Status for our research

**CLEAN NEGATIVE for "Honoria/Nora filia Patricii Gleeson et Margaritae Moloney" baptism.** Single Gemini pass; no entry for Patrick + Margaret Moloney parents in this window. See [[gleeson-nora-1876-1939-sister]].

## Notable kin-network entries

- **20 Aug 1876:** Thomas, filius Joannis Shea et Mariae Flaherty. Sponsors: **Thomas Shea** et Margarita Flaherty. → Thomas Shea sponsor recurrence (cf. Honora Gleeson 1866 baptism with same Thomas Shea sponsor); reinforces [[gleeson-patrick-natal-family]] T3 hypothesis that Bridget Gleeson m. Thomas Shea is Patrick's sister.
- **27 Jan 1877:** Carolus, filius Caroli Moloney et Mariae Annae Riordan. Sponsors: Joanne Moran et Maria Beeny. → Charles/Carolus Moloney as Croom father; possible Moloney kin to Margaret (see [[gleeson-james-moloney-margaret-brother]]).
